title: AG40023: Horticulture And Floriculture Technology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Classification of Fruit and Flower Crops: Soils and climate, Fruit and flower
crops for major agro-ecological regions. Propagation Techniques: Modern
techniques of raising seedlings, Vegetative propagation, Micropropagation.
Nursery Management: Field management and green house technology Cultural
Practices of Orchards and Flower Gardens: Planting methods, Training and
prunning, Nutrient management, Biofertilizer, Fertilization, Plant hormones,
Plant protection measures, microbial pesticides, Crop growth assessment.
Harvest and Post Harvest: Cut flower, Dry flower, Storage preservation and
packaging of fruits and flowers, Quality assessment.
